scope: MS-A-NCR v2 correctness patch and targeted Working-Memory refinement

confirmed_issues.detail: The pilot solver computes D for all FC edges but applies D only to Laplacian-active FC edges. Inactive FC edges use lambda_fc times identity in both fitting and prediction, contrary to the stated full-FC objective.

The pilot caches eigenvalues of lambda_fc*D + lambda_L*L by lambda_L/lambda_fc only. Eigenvectors are ratio-invariant but the cached eigenvalues retain the absolute lambda_fc scale; cached and uncached solves therefore disagree across proportional penalty pairs.
The completed pilot config and outputs contain only matched and random priors. Unrelated and shuffled controls were not evaluated.
The completed pilot used only prod lifting, gamma in {0,1}, lambda_L in {0,1}, and lambda_fc/lambda_sc in {0.1,1,10}.
The pilot uses one deterministic 15% inner validation split and selects every model by validation RMSE, rather than 3-fold inner CV with Pearson as the primary endpoint.

A0 uses sklearn Ridge without the custom dual feature-count convention and does not refit on train+validation, while A4 and prior models use the custom dual formulation and refit. A4 remains the scientifically relevant no-prior comparator.
Existing grid assertions use hard-coded lists and do not exercise the production config or runner path. Existing MS-A-NCR tests do not establish direct-primal equivalence or cache correctness.
The existing MS-A-NCR node_saliency method uses X^T alpha as a proxy rather than the exact generalized-Ridge coefficient P^{-1}X^T alpha.
The pilot catches all candidate exceptions without recording them and can fall back to zero predictions.

split_audit.outer: iter_nested_splits uses shuffled subject-wise KFold when groups is null and GroupKFold when groups are supplied.
split_audit.pilot_inner: Within each outer trainval partition, make_inner_split creates one deterministic train/validation split using seed*1000+fold.
split_audit.refinement_required_inner: Use a new deterministic 3-fold split restricted to each outer training partition; fit every scaler only on the corresponding inner-training indices.
split_audit.limitation: No family/group file was found under inputs and configs set groups_path to null, so the refinement must retain subject-wise splitting and record this limitation.

assumptions_revised.original: The existing eig_cache is a valid speed optimization.
assumptions_revised.revision: It is invalid as implemented. The exact refinement will cache the eigendecomposition of D_active^{-1/2} L_active D_active^{-1/2}, whose basis is independent of lambda_fc and lambda_L.

assumptions_revised.original: The pilot evaluated 5 models x 2 targets x 4 priors x 2 liftings.
assumptions_revised.revision: That table describes the intended design; the completed pilot actually evaluated 5 models x 2 targets x 2 priors x 1 lifting across 3 seeds x 5 folds (300 rows).

The existing custom dual convention divides X P^{-1} X^T by 2*n_edges, equivalent to multiplying the written penalty by the feature-count scale. The refinement preserves this established convention and makes direct-primal tests include the same scale.

preservation_constraints: Do not overwrite outputs/iclr/msancr_pilot or Phase-B outputs.
Use load_connectomes and the repository outer-split semantics.
Use seed means for final paired summaries; n=3 results are descriptive only.
Do not launch the final 10-seed x 5-fold experiment.
